references.text: Moses gathered all Israel to speak to them, which demonstrates his leadership role and communication with the people.
Moses came and spoke all the words of this song to the people, a similar act where Moses addresses all Israel.
Moses came and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words, a corresponding pattern where Moses conveys God's word to Israel.
The Lord spoke to Moses about his impending death and the need for a successor, which is the context for Moses' speech in Deuteronomy 31.
The introduction to Deuteronomy where Moses speaks to all Israel, the same pattern as in chapter 31.
Moses summoned all Israel and spoke to them, the same communication pattern as in chapter 31.
